html:
G'oya

O'zaro kuzatish jadvalda ikki qator bo'lib turadi: (1, 2) va (2, 1). follows ni o'zi bilan bog'lab, har bir qatorga uning teskarisini qidiramiz. Topilgan juftliklardan follower_id < followee_id bo'lganini qoldiramiz va users dan ismlarni olamiz.

Yechim

SELECT u1.username AS user1, u2.username AS user2
FROM follows a
JOIN follows b ON b.follower_id = a.followee_id AND b.followee_id = a.follower_id
JOIN users u1 ON u1.id = a.follower_id
JOIN users u2 ON u2.id = a.followee_id
WHERE a.follower_id < a.followee_id

Har bir o'zaro juftlik ikki marta topiladi, (1, 2) dan ham, (2, 1) dan ham. a.follower_id < a.followee_id ulardan bittasini qoldiradi. O'zini kuzatish (3, 3) ham o'zining teskarisi sifatida topiladi, lekin 3 < 3 yolg'on va u tushib qoladi.

Namunada aziz bilan dilnoza, jasur bilan malika bir-birini kuzatadi. aziz jasurni kuzatadi, lekin jasur azizni kuzatmaydi, bu juftlik emas.

Tuzoqlar

Filtrsiz so'rov har bir juftlikni ikki marta chiqaradi: namunada 2 o'rniga 4 qator.

Noto'g'riSELECT u1.username AS user1, u2.username AS user2
FROM follows a
JOIN follows b ON b.follower_id = a.followee_id AND b.followee_id = a.follower_id
JOIN users u1 ON u1.id = a.follower_id
JOIN users u2 ON u2.id = a.followee_id

<= yozilsa, o'zini kuzatgan foydalanuvchi o'zi bilan "juftlik" bo'lib chiqadi.

Boshqa yo'l

Teskari qatorni EXISTS bilan tekshirish ham mumkin. JOIN'dagidek ikki marta topish muammosi yo'q, filtr esa baribir kerak:

SELECT u1.username AS user1, u2.username AS user2
FROM follows a
JOIN users u1 ON u1.id = a.follower_id
JOIN users u2 ON u2.id = a.followee_id
WHERE a.follower_id < a.followee_id
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM follows b
    WHERE b.follower_id = a.followee_id AND b.followee_id = a.follower_id
  )
